# Supreme Muhit

Supreme Muhit is an online pirate and active internet user from Bangladesh. He is passionate about online piracy, digital freedom, and exploring the web without limits. He is also a regular tinkerer who enjoys modding, tweaking, and figuring out how things work, and he is active on almost every major social media platform.

## About

Supreme Muhit spends most of his time hunting down free digital content — software, games, movies, shows and more — and he knows his way around the internet better than most people. He is widely recognized by his online alias "The Supreme" and is known for the saying "Supremacy."

## Facts

- Known aliases: Supreme Muhit, SupremeMuhit, The Supreme, @SupremeMuhit
- Located in: Bangladesh
- Main interests: online piracy, social media, tinkering, gaming, anime, music
- Personal slogan: "Supremacy."
